landmark_exclusions.note: Reasons can overlap; unique included count is in the model.

controls: state; groups below 500 customers pooled by count
purchase quarter; adjacent early/sparse quarters pooled to at least 500 by count
adjusted_model.model: binomial GLM with HC1 covariance; day-30 landmark

planning_sensitivity.design: Independent two-proportion normal approximation; two-sided alpha 0.05, power 0.80; observed landmark group sizes and on-time baseline fixed as planning assumptions. Not the adjusted GLM's power or a causal guarantee.

decision: Late deliveries are associated with worse reviews; no statistically detectable repeat-purchase association appears in the adjusted landmark model. Do not book retention savings: the day-31–90 repeat difference is -0.16 percentage points (95% CI -0.45 to +0.13). Prioritize an operational review in MA, CE, BA based on first-order lateness, and test customer outcomes prospectively.
